questions: What medical facilities are available at SASTRA?
is there a hospital inside SASTRA
what should I do if I fall sick on campus
answer: SASTRA's in-house hospital is Vaidyanatha Arogyasala. It has 10 beds, regular doctors and paramedical staff, and is equipped to handle medical emergencies round the clock. On-campus medical consultation is offered free; other costs such as off-campus visits, prescriptions, tests, ambulance service and hospital care remain the student's responsibility.
source: SASTRA Hospital — Vaidyanatha Arogyasala (official)

questions: What sports facilities are available at SASTRA?
does SASTRA have an indoor sports stadium
what games can I play in Maruti indoor stadium
are there badminton and table tennis facilities
is there a gym at SASTRA
answer: SASTRA's MARUTI indoor stadium has billiards tables, badminton courts, a basketball court, table tennis and carrom facilities. The university also has a fitness centre in the stadium, a separate gymnasium and jogging track for women, and outdoor facilities for sports including soccer, tennis and cricket.
source: SASTRA Sports Facilities (official)

questions: What is the Academic Bank of Credits ID?
how do I register for ABC ID
what is academic bank of credits
answer: The Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) lets students open an academic account and digitally store, verify, accumulate and transfer eligible credits earned from participating higher-education institutions. SASTRA asks its students to register through www.abc.gov.in with the required details.
source: Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) Registration — SASTRA official

questions: Where can I find the SASTRA campus map?
how do I navigate SASTRA campus
answer: SASTRA publishes an official campus map for the Thanjavur campus on its website. Use the map to locate schools and campus facilities; if you are unsure of a destination, ask the relevant office or a campus volunteer for directions.
source: Campus Map — SASTRA official

questions: what does choice based credit system mean
how are courses organised in SASTRA BTech
core department and open electives SASTRA
answer: SASTRA's B.Tech. programme uses the Choice-Based Credit System (CBCS). Students complete core courses as well as department and open electives; the elective structure lets students pursue areas of interest within the programme while meeting the required credits for the degree.
source: SASTRA MHRD/UGC compliance — curricular structure (official)

questions: What is the Semester Abroad Programme?
can I do final semester project abroad
answer: SASTRA's Semester Abroad Programme (SAP) enables final-semester students to undertake project work or course work at partner universities abroad. The university also encourages summer internships at prestigious research institutions and industries; eligibility, selection and available destinations are determined through the programme's current process.
source: SAP — SASTRA official

questions: What is Knowledge Connect at SASTRA?
where can I find SASTRA research papers
does SASTRA have an online research repository
answer: Knowledge Connect @ SASTRA is the university libraries' institutional repository. It provides access to research and scholarly output that has been selected and deposited by SASTRA departments and centres.
source: Knowledge Connect @ SASTRA (official repository)

questions: Where is the SASTRA Thanjavur main campus?
how to reach SASTRA Thanjavur campus
answer: SASTRA Deemed University’s main campus is at Tirumalaisamudram, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu 613401. The official campus map can help you locate buildings and facilities after you arrive.

questions: Where is the SASTRA Chennai campus?
how to reach SASTRA Chennai campus
answer: SASTRA University Chennai Campus is at No. 21, A. V. Meiyappan Salai, Arcot Road, Vadapalani, Chennai 600026. Its official contact number is 044 2365 0027 and e-mail is sastracc@sastra.ac.in.

questions: what student clubs are there at SASTRA

questions: who helps with first year orientation at SASTRA
answer: SCOS means Student Citizens of SASTRA. It is the student body through which SASTRA’s Student Council functions; its coordinators recruit volunteers for programmes such as first-year orientation, parent interactions and placement drives.

questions: does SASTRA offer mentoring and counselling
where can I get career counselling at SASTRA
answer: SWAS is SASTRA’s Centre for Student Wellness Activities and Support. It provides student support including mentoring, counselling, academic guidance, peer mentorship, career counselling, orientation and transition support. For an urgent medical or mental-health situation, contact the campus hospital or emergency services rather than relying on the bot.
source: SWAS — Student Wellness Activities & Support (SASTRA official)

questions: what facilities are in SASTRA central library

what is available in central library SASTRA
answer: SASTRA’s central library, Saraswathi Sadan, has study areas, an audio-visual room, internet access and reprographic facilities. It also provides access to library books and online databases. Check the library directly for current access, borrowing and timing rules.
source: Saraswathi Sadan — SASTRA Central Library (official)
